title: Bring the radial menu back for the user: Tab opens Gallery / Projects / Flows / Latest workspace
description:
Fabio, 2026-09-18. MPI-378 killed the user radial because the ring had a single item left. Flows and the remembered last card now give it four real destinations, so Tab goes back to being the radial opener and the three-state Tab FLIPPER is retired (one key cannot be both).

Layout, Fabio's call - diagonals, not the cardinal points the renderer computes by default:
- Gallery           top-left
- Projects (landing) bottom-left
- Flows             top-right
- Latest workspace  bottom-right

Latest workspace greys out (disabled, never selectable) when resolveFlipTarget() returns null - no cards, or a remembered card since deleted.

Ctrl+Tab stays the dev radial, minus its Flows item (now a user destination).

Accent: the radial rebinds --accent-heat to --hub-accent (Studio cream, the mascot accent) - DESIGN.md 'The accent family'. A block rebinding --accent-heat MUST restate --accent-heat-hi in the same rule.

Files: js/components/Primitives/MpiRadialMenu/{MpiRadialMenu.js,MpiRadialMenu.css}, js/shell/navigation.js, js/managers/hotkeyRegistry.js.

AMENDED 2026-09-19, both from Fabio:
1. PROJECTS IS OUT, MODELS IS IN (bottom-left). "Going back to projects doesn't make much sense unless the landing page also had a radial menu" - it was a one-way door out of the only surface the menu exists on. The Models leg emits `models:open`, which carries its own no-engine guard.
2. THE RADIAL MUST OPEN OVER EVERY SURFACE. "It's a selector. If we are in flows, we need to be able to access it." The first cut gated Tab off whenever a body overlay was up, because MpiOverlay stashes every sibling of its mount target into a `display: none` div and a stashed radial fires, navigates on release and draws NOTHING. Fixed by PLACEMENT rather than a gate: #radial-mount is now a direct child of <body>, spared by name in MpiOverlay's body-mode stash the way #titlebar and the toast stack already were, position: fixed at z-index 19000 (over the overlay manager's 10000+10/depth, under the 20000 toast stack). The only surface test left in the when-gate is the page; a `.mpi-modal` still blocks, because a modal is a question waiting on an answer. Page destinations now go through _leaveOverlaySurfaces(): flow:suspend FIRST (park, never close), then sweep the overlay stack with Overlays.closeTopOverlay().
